The bay receives freshwater inflow from a number of small rivers and streams rising on the hum id northern slopes of the Alborz Mountains. Some freshwater marshes occur at the western end of the ba y, where freshwater input is greatest. There are extensive tracts of seasonally flooded tamarisk woodland on that side of the bay, too. The Lapoo-Zaghmarz Ab-bandans are long, narrow freshwater lagoons located at the landward end of Miankaleh Peninsula, about 10 km west of Gorg an Bay.
